question: During 2025-26, India's overall goods and services exports are expected to reach ________.
solution: The correct answer is __**$1 trillion**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **India** has set an ambitious target to reach **$1 trillion** in total exports of goods and services by the fiscal year **2025-26**. • This goal is a significant milestone in the country's journey toward becoming a **$5 trillion economy**. The **Ministry of Commerce and Industry** is the primary body overseeing the strategies to achieve this growth. • The target reflects a robust growth trajectory, building upon the momentum gained when **India** crossed the **$750 billion** mark in total exports during the **2022-23** period. • Achieving **$1 trillion** involves a concerted effort to boost both **merchandise exports** (physical goods) and **services exports** (IT, consultancy, etc.), leveraging **India’s** competitive advantages in global markets. • The government is focusing on enhancing **export competitiveness** by improving **infrastructure**, reducing **logistical costs**, and fostering **innovation** through various industrial policies.
